note: The Central African Republic: nationals of the 14 countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days; Emiratis get a 90-day visa on arrival (by the UAE's foreign ministry); everyone else needs a visa from a Central African or French mission (the e-Visa portal is in test mode; the US exemption ended on 17 November 2023). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of the Central African Republic
sources.said: Visitors to the Central African Republic must obtain a visa from one of the Central African Republic diplomatic missions or French diplomatic missions unless they come from one of the visa exempt countries. ... Citizens of the following 14 countries can visit Central African Republic without a visa for up to the duration listed below: 90 days Benin Burkina Faso Burundi Cameroon Chad Republic of the Congo Côte d'Ivoire Equatorial Guinea Gabon Israel Liberia Niger Rwanda Senegal ... citizens of United Arab Emirates may obtain a visa on arrival for a maximum stay of 90 days.
